bagPolicy.summary: Bags or backpacks may not exceed 10 x 15 x 30 cm and are preferably clear. Small handbags and fanny packs may not exceed 11 x 16 cm; medium clear storage bags are also allowed.
allowed: bags/backpacks up to 10 x 15 x 30 cm
small handbags up to 11 x 16 cm
fanny packs up to 11 x 16 cm
prohibited: backpacks larger than 10 x 15 x 30 cm
bagPolicy.note: All items remain subject to security inspection and event restrictions.

parking.note: The Estadio GNP Seguros offers parking with access through gates 7, 8, 9, and 15 of the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez and Ciudad Deportiva Magdalena Mixhuca. Access points may vary depending on the event configuration and location.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Estadio GNP Seguros's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The venue offers a premium gastronomic experience with comfort food and beverages available in a lounge area. These offerings are part of the hospitality benefits for Boxes Diamante and Boxes Oro ticket holders.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Estadio GNP Seguros, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Estadio GNP Seguros's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Estadio GNP Seguros. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Estadio GNP Seguros. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
